reason: Editor localization adds exactly five production modules: Lingui configuration, browser/runtime adapter, language preference row, active-locale display formatting, and a shared-PO compilation adapter (the shared packages do not yet export compiled catalogues). The runtime replaces implicit browser-locale formatting and English literals without adding a collection owner or remote service. Eight exports expose those boundaries and two type-presentation helpers relocated out of TypeBrowser to stay below its existing line ceiling. Ten relative imports connect the runtime, display formatting and real-English test setup. Settings moves without a compatibility wrapper; production catalogue JSON/PO is data, not extra implementation modules.
